targets.title: Errors Are Aversive
targets.evidence_quote: The main goal of the replication project was to attempt to reproduce a published finding using as close to identical methods and analyses as possible.
targets.outcome_quote: For this reason, we consider this to be a failure to replicate but with extremely similar results.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict decides despite similar basic ERN/EPS effects. Full original citation and DOI are absent from this report; title and author names appear on its title page.

targets.evidence_quote: Therefore, we attempted this same analysis strategy and performed a median split based on ERN amplitude and re-assessed the correlation between ERN and EPS magnitude in this subgroup of participants (see Figure 4).
targets.outcome_quote: Consistent with the Riesel et al. (2013) study, we found a significant correlation between ERN and EPS in this subgroup of participants (r = -.63, p < .01).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Additional analysis explicitly re-tests the later published subgroup finding and reports agreement. The subsequent removal of an outlier is exploratory. Citation is inline only; title and DOI are absent.
